title: Two-Shape Animal · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Two-Shape Animal · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose an animal that can be suggested with simple shapes. The lead draws it using only two closed shapes and no written letters. The group identifies the intended animal. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Two-Shape Animal, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group identifies the intended animal.
recall.why: The group identifies the intended animal.
